mapper.select: WITH CNTR AS ( SELECT A.CONTRACT_NUM , A.CUSTOMER_ID --, A.USER_SSN 2026.05.20 변경전 :: 고객데이터 조회시 주민등록번호는 MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO.USER_SSN 이 아닌 MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO.CUSTOMER_SSN 으로 조회되야함. , CRYPTO_AES256.DEC_AES(D.CUSTOMER_SSN) AS USER_SSN -- 2026.05.20 변경 후 , D.DRIVR_LICNS_NO , D.TAX_ID , D.CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME , A.SUBSCRIBER_NO , A.SUB_STATUS , A.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE , A.ICC_ID , A.LGL_AGNT_SSN , ( -- 기변이력이 2건 이상인 경우 처리를 위하여 MAX 사용 SELECT MAX(ENGG_INFO) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT MAX(DECODE(X.GRNT_INSR_MNGM_NO, 'none', SUBSTR(X.APP_START_DD, 1, 8), SUBSTR(X.GRNT_INSR_MNGM_NO, 1, 8)) || NVL(X.ENGG_MNTH_CNT, '0')) OVER (PARTITION BY X.CONTRACT_NUM) AS ENGG_INFO FROM MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO X , MSP_DVC_CHG_AGNT_HST Y WHERE X.CONTRACT_NUM = (SELECT MAX(CONTRACT_NUM) FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{customerMobileNo} AND PPPO = 'PO' AND SUB_STATUS <> 'C') AND X.MODEL_CHN_CD = '01' AND X.CONTRACT_NUM = Y.CONTRACT_NUM AND X.EVNT_TRTM_NO = Y.EVNT_TRTM_NO AND Y.APPL_END_DTTM LIKE '99991231%' AND Y.EVNT_CD = 'C07' UNION -- 심플할인 -- SIM_START_DT 최대 값을 구하고 -- SIM_START_DT 최대 값에 대한 약정 개월... SELECT SUBSTR(X.SIM_START_DT, 1, 8) || X.ENGG_MNTH_CNT FROM MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO X WHERE X.CONTRACT_NUM = (SELECT MAX(CONTRACT_NUM) FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{customerMobileNo} AND PPPO = 'PO' AND SUB_STATUS <> 'C') AND X.EVNT_CD = 'SIM' AND X.GRNT_INSR_STAT_CD = 'A' AND X.APP_END_DATE LIKE '99991231%' AND X.SIM_START_DT = ( SELECT MAX(X2.SIM_START_DT) FROM MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO X2 WHERE X2.CONTRACT_NUM = (SELECT MAX(CONTRACT_NUM) FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{customerMobileNo} AND PPPO = 'PO' AND SUB_STATUS <> 'C') AND X2.EVNT_CD = 'SIM' AND X2.GRNT_INSR_STAT_CD = 'A' AND X2.APP_END_DATE LIKE '99991231%' GROUP BY X2.CONTRACT_NUM ) UNION -- 기변개발전 우수기변 대상 SELECT DECODE(X.GRNT_INSR_MNGM_NO, 'none', MIN(SUBSTR(X.APP_START_DD, 1, 8)), SUBSTR(X.GRNT_INSR_MNGM_NO, 1, 8)) || MAX(X.ENGG_MNTH_CNT) FROM MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO X WHERE X.CONTRACT_NUM = (SELECT MAX(CONTRACT_NUM) FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{customerMobileNo} AND PPPO = 'PO' AND SUB_STATUS <> 'C') AND X.EVNT_CD IN ('UPD','UAD') AND X.MODEL_CHN_CD = '01' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MSP_DVC_CHG_AGNT_HST WHERE CONTRACT_NUM = X.CONTRACT_NUM AND APPL_END_DTTM LIKE '99991231%' ) GROUP BY X.GRNT_INSR_MNGM_NO, X.CONTRACT_NUM UNION -- 일반적인 경우 SELECT DISTINCT X.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE || NVL(Y.ENGG_MNTH_CNT, '0') FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO X , MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO Y WHERE X.CONTRACT_NUM = (SELECT MAX(CONTRACT_NUM) FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{customerMobileNo} AND PPPO = 'PO' AND SUB_STATUS <> 'C') AND X.CONTRACT_NUM = Y.CONTRACT_NUM AND Y.MODEL_CHN_CD <> '01' AND Y.ENGG_MNTH_CNT IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO WHERE CONTRACT_NUM = Y.CONTRACT_NUM AND EVNT_CD = 'SIM' AND GRNT_INSR_STAT_CD = 'A' AND APP_END_DATE LIKE '99991231%' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO WHERE CONTRACT_NUM = Y.CONTRACT_NUM AND EVNT_CD IN ('UPD', 'UAD') AND MODEL_CHN_CD = '01' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MSP_DVC_CHG_AGNT_HST WHERE CONTRACT_NUM = X.CONTRACT_NUM AND APPL_END_DTTM LIKE '99991231%' ) ) ) AS ENGG_INFO , DECODE(B.CONTRACT_NUM, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS HIST_YN , DECODE(B.CONTRACT_NUM, NULL, '', SUBSTR(MAX(B.APPL_STRT_DTTM) OVER(PARTITION BY B.APPL_STRT_DTTM), 1, 8)) AS DVC_CHG_DT , C.ENGG_MNTH_CNT AS DVC_ENGG_MNTH_CNT FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO A , MSP_DVC_CHG_AGNT_HST B , MSP_JUO_ADD_INFO C , MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO D WHERE A.SUB_STATUS <> 'C' AND A.PPPO = 'PO' AND A.CONTRACT_NUM = B.CONTRACT_NUM(+) AND B.REQUEST_KEY(+) IS NOT NULL AND ( B.APPL_END_DTTM(+) LIKE '99991231%' OR TO_DATE(SUBSTR(B.APPL_END_DTTM(+), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(B.APPL_STRT_DTTM(+), 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') >= 15 ) AND B.CONTRACT_NUM = C.CONTRACT_NUM(+) AND B.EVNT_TRTM_NO = C.EVNT_TRTM_NO(+) AND A.CUSTOMER_ID = D.CUSTOMER_ID AND UPPER(D.CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME) = UPPER(TRIM(#{customerLinkName})) AND A.SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{customerMobileNo} ORDER BY B.APPL_STRT_DTTM DESC ) SELECT A.CONTRACT_NUM CONTRACT_NUM -- 가입계약번호 , A.CUSTOMER_ID CUSTOMER_ID -- 고객아이디 , A.USER_SSN CUSTOMER_SSN -- 주민등록번호 , A.DRIVR_LICNS_NO , A.TAX_ID , A.CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME -- 고객이름 , A.SUBSCRIBER_NO SUBSCRIBER_NO -- 전화번호_이전CTN , A.LGL_AGNT_SSN , CASE WHEN A.HIST_YN = 'Y' AND SYSDATE - TO_DATE(A.DVC_CHG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') < 15 THEN 'N' WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.ENGG_INFO,1,8), 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_NUMBER(NVL(SUBSTR(A.ENGG_INFO, 9,2), 0))) - SYSDATE > TO_NUMBER(B.CD_VAL) THEN 'E' ELSE 'Y' END AS DVC_CHG_YN , LST_COM_ACTV_DATE /* 개통일자 추가 20260423 */ FROM CNTR A , CMN_GRP_CD_MST B WHERE B.GRP_ID = 'RCP0028' AND B.ETC1 = '10' AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT SUB_STATUS FROM ( SELECT A.SUB_STATUS FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO A WHERE A.SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{subscriberNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN A.SUB_STATUS <> 'C' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.CONTRACT_NUM DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT SVC_CNTR_NO, CONTRACT_NUM, CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME, SUBSCRIBER_NO, LST_COM_ACTV_DATE, CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, FST_ESIM_YN FROM ( SELECT A.SVC_CNTR_NO, A.CONTRACT_NUM, D.CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME, A.SUBSCRIBER_NO, A.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE, D.CUSTOMER_ID, D.CUSTOMER_TYPE, C.FST_ESIM_YN FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO A , MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO D , MSP_REQUEST_DTL C WHERE A.CUSTOMER_ID = D.CUSTOMER_ID AND A.CONTRACT_NUM = C.CONTRACT_NUM(+) AND A.SUB_STATUS <> 'C' AND A.SUBSCRIBER_NO = #{subscriberNo} AND REPLACE(D.CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME, ' ') = REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(#{customerLinkName})), ' ') AND ( -- 개인/미성년자: 생년월일 또는 주민번호로 검증 ( D.CUSTOMER_TYPE NOT IN ('B', 'G') AND ( A.DOBYYYYMMDD = #{customerSsn} OR ( #{cstmrType} IN ('NM', 'FM') AND SUBSTR(CRYPTO_AES256.DEC_AES(D.CUSTOMER_SSN), 1, 6) = SUBSTR(#{customerSsn}, 3, 6) ) ) ) -- 법인/공공기관: 사업자번호 또는 법인등록번호로 검증 OR ( D.CUSTOMER_TYPE IN ('B', 'G') AND ( D.TAX_ID = #{bizNo} OR D.DRIVR_LICNS_NO = #{cstmrJuridicalRrn} ) ) ) ORDER BY A.CONTRACT_NUM DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

/** 통합청구 청구계정ID 조회 **/ SELECT BAN, CUSTOMER_ID, COL_DELINQ_STATUS, MARKET_GUBUN, BL_BILLING_METHOD, BANK_ACCT_HOLDER_ID, BAN_LINK_NAME, CONTRACT_NUM, EVNT_TRTM_DT FROM (SELECT A.BAN, A.CUSTOMER_ID, A.COL_DELINQ_STATUS, A.MARKET_GUBUN, A.BL_BILLING_METHOD, A.BANK_ACCT_HOLDER_ID, A.BAN_LINK_NAME, B.CONTRACT_NUM, A.EVNT_TRTM_DT FROM (SELECT BAN, CUSTOMER_ID, COL_DELINQ_STATUS, MARKET_GUBUN, BL_BILLING_METHOD, BL_SPCL_BAN_CODE, BANK_ACCT_HOLDER_ID, BAN_LINK_NAME, EVNT_TRTM_DT FROM MSP_JUO_BAN_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND BL_BILLING_METHOD != 'R' -- 지로 제외 AND COL_DELINQ_STATUS != 'D' -- 미납 제외 AND MARKET_GUBUN = 'KIS' AND BAN = #{ban} -- 파라미터 : 청구계정ID ) A INNER JOIN (SELECT CONTRACT_NUM, BAN, CUSTOMER_ID FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO WHERE BAN = #{ban}) B ON B.BAN = A.BAN AND B.CUSTOMER_ID = A.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CUSTOMER_SSN, DRIVR_LICNS_NO, TAX_ID, CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME, CUST_IDNT_NO_IND_CD FROM MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO WHERE 1=1
AND UPPER(CUSTOMER_LINK_NAME) = UPPER(TRIM(#{customerLinkName})) -- 고객명 AND CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{cstmrTypeCd.customerType} -- 고객구분 (I/B/G) AND (CUSTOMER_SSN = CRYPTO_AES256.ENC_AES(#{customerSsn}) OR DRIVR_LICNS_NO = #{customerSsn} OR TAX_ID = #{customerSsn}) -- 고객 식별번호 ) C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = B.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY A.EVNT_TRTM_DT DESC ) BAN WHERE ROWNUM = 1
